messages.content: You identify patterns in complete email texts. Respond with valid JSON.

Please write a BRIEF 15-20 word executive summary of the theme "Email and Cloud Services" as it appears in the following examples.
['Your Apple ID has been used to open a session iCloud from an unauthorized computer.', 'Facebook sent you a message.', 'We are closing all old version of Cornell Mailbox as from June. 30th.', 'We hereby bring to your notice once again that the details of this email account has already been deleted from our database, and in a short time your email account may experience error which will lead to deactivation.', 'BT is improving your email service and action is needed by you to ensure that you continue to receive email.', 'In order for AOL Online access to continue uninterrupted, please update your billing information today.', "You should know that you recently tried to log in in to Dropbox with a password already expired that you haven't changed in a while.", 'Your email account has been blacklisted, because you are required to re-verify your account.', 'This is the last mention to communicate you as of 20 Oct 2016 that you have not yet updated your iCloud ID details.', 'Pauline Dewberry is trying to call you on Skype.', 'Your access to Online Services has been suspended due to a mismatch of access code between your Billing details.', 'Our record indicates that your mail quota is full, and your email will be deactivated, and this request will be processed shortly.', 'Your Apple ID was used to sign in to iCloud on an iMac.', 'Mailbox Server update.', 'For questions about secure e-mail encryption service, please contact technical support at 888.474.7428.', 'Facebook sent you a message.', 'This is an automatic message from our servers; If you are receiving this message it means that your email address has been queued for deactivation.', 'Under quot;Know your Customer (KYC)quot; modulation Apple is mandated by directions to perform a verification of your information, omission to do so will take effect in the cessation of your Apple ID within the next three days.', 'Your e-mailbox password will soon expire.']

DO NOT write the summary as a third party using terms like "the text examples" or "they discuss", but write the summary from the perspective of the text authors making the points directly.
Please respond ONLY with a valid JSON in the following format:
{
    "summary": "<SUMMARY>"
}

message.content: {"summary":"We notify you of email and cloud account activity, service updates, security concerns, and urgent requests to verify details or prevent access disruption."}
